Spiritual Focus.text: Gives your Flash of Light and Holy Light spells a 14% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

Improved Seal of Righteousness.text: Increases the damage done by your Seal of Righteousness and Judgement of Righteousness by 3%.

Healing Light.text: Increases the amount healed by your Holy Light and Flash of Light spells by 4%.

Consecration.text: Consecrates the land beneath Paladin, doing 64 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area.

Improved Lay on Hands.text: Gives the target of your Lay on Hands spell a 15% bonus to their armor value from items for 2 min. In addition, the cooldown for your Lay on Hands spell is reduced by 10 min.

Unyielding Faith.text: Increases your chance to resist Fear and Disorient effects by an additional 5%.

Illumination.text: After getting a critical effect from your Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock heal spell, gives you a 20% chance to gain Mana equal to the base cost of the spell.

Improved Blessing of Wisdom.text: Increases the effect of your Blessing of Wisdom spell by 10%.

Divine Favor.text: When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a 100% critical effect chance.

Lasting Judgement.text: Increases the duration of your Judgement of Light and Judgement of Wisdom by 10 sec.

Holy Power.text: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by 1%.

Holy Shock.text: Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing 204 to 220 Holy damage to an enemy, or 204 to 220 healing to an ally.

Improved Devotion Aura.text: Increases the armor bonus of your Devotion Aura by 5%.

Redoubt.text: Increases your chance to block attacks with your shield by 6% after being the victim of a critical strike. Lasts 10 sec or 5 blocks.

Precision.text: Increases your chance to hit with melee weapons by 1%.

Guardian's Favor.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Blessing of Protection by 60 sec and increases the duration of your Blessing of Freedom by 3 sec.

Toughness.text: Increases your armor value from items by 2%.

Blessing of Kings.text: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing total stats by 10% for 5 min. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

Improved Righteous Fury.text: Increases the amount of threat generated by your Righteous Fury spell by 16%.

Shield Specialization.text: Increases the amount of damage absorbed by your shield by 10%.

Improved Hammer of Justice.text: Decreases the cooldown of your Hammer of Justice spell by 5 sec.

Improved Concentration Aura.text: Increases the effect of your Concentration Aura by an additional 5% and gives all group members affected by the aura an additional 5% chance to resist Silence and Interrupt effects.

Blessing of Sanctuary.text: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, reducing damage dealt from all sources by up to 10 for 5 min. In addition, when the target blocks a melee attack the attacker will take 14 Holy damage. Players may only have one

Reckoning.text: Gives you a 20% chance to gain an extra attack after being the victim of a critical strike.

One-Handed Weapon Specialization.text: Increases the damage you deal with one-handed melee weapons by 2%.

Holy Shield.text: Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec, and deals 65 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active. Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. 4 charges.

Improved Blessing of Might.text: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Blessing of Might by 4%.

Benediction.text: Reduces the Mana cost of your Judgement and Seal spells by 3%.

Improved Judgement.text: Decreases the cooldown of your Judgement spell by 1 sec.

Improved Seal of the Crusader.text: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Seal of the Crusader and the Holy damage increase of your Judgement of the Crusader by 5%.

Vindication.text: Gives the Paladin's damaging melee attacks a chance to reduce the target's Strength and Agility by 5% for 10 sec.

Conviction.text: Increases your chance to get a critical strike with melee weapons by 1%.

Seal of Command.text: Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 70% of normal weapon damage. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Lasts 30 sec.Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy,

Pursuit of Justice.text: Increases movement and mounted movement speed by 4%. This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

Eye for an Eye.text: All spell criticals against you cause 15% of the damage taken to the caster as well. The damage caused by Eye for an Eye will not exceed 50% of the Paladin's total health.

Improved Retribution Aura.text: Increases the damage done by your Retribution Aura by 25%.

Two-Handed Weapon Specialization.text: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 2%.

Sanctity Aura.text: Increases Holy damage done by party members within 30 yards by 10%. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Vengeance.text: Gives you a 3% bonus to Physical and Holy damage you deal for 8 sec after dealing a critical strike from a weapon swing, spell, or ability.

Repentance.text: Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to 6 sec. Any damage caused will awaken the target. Only works against Humanoids.
